Record notes

Superseded by Writing Templates 0.1.4. The corrective version limits synthetic sample generation to its licensed runtime files and four authored fixture profiles, including when run beside a full private collection. The original 0.1.3 archive remains unchanged.

Complete writing chooser, routed source-verified handoffs and offline draft QA for explicitly supplied external collections.

Version 0.1.3 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Complete runtime and source integrity checks; private and uncleared real-voice corpus excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared MCP dependencies; Your own authorized writing-source catalog.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add writing-templates@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from a12727e05886910a5830485bab497e7cadabd8c0. SHA-256: 33071d99e1289a10f8edc2509dab34f1de6b7044a2ed4a202dda78d58d448959.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
